bio: With its suggestion of elegance, the name – meaning emperor's hall – sets the tone. Once a renowned ballroom, Kaisersaal boasts high ceilings, stuccowork, fine hardwood floors and pleasant design details. The kitchen in a glass cube in the entrance area is eye-catching; it is also where the team led by chef Kevin Leitner, who previously earned a MICHELIN star for s'Äpfle, in Bodman, cooks up classic and Mediterranean-based dishes, which are given a creative and modern twist. Friendly service is provided by attentive staff, as you savour dishes such as Norwegian scallop, rhubarb, nasturtium, vin jaune & pursley or bison, back, top blade, grilled spring leek & polenta, either as part of a set menu or à la carte.
